idea-plugin.name: Phantom Endpoints
idea-plugin.description: The Endpoints tool window: every HTTP endpoint that installed plugins report (Spring MVC and WebFlux, Ktor, …), grouped by module, with a filter field. Enter or double-click opens the handler; Generate HTTP Request adds a request for the endpoint to the scratch file generated-requests.http, with the host and port taken from the module's Spring Boot or Ktor configuration. Nothing is computed while the window stays closed, and projects without endpoints don't get the window.
